outgoing.name: 20th century
outgoing.excerpt: Luk thung, or Thai country music, developed in the mid-20th century to reflect daily trials and tribulations of rural Thais.

outgoing.excerpt: Mor lam is the dominant folk music of Thailand's north-eastern Isan region, which has a mainly Lao population.

outgoing.name: Latin America
outgoing.excerpt: Ponsri Woranut and Suraphol Sombatcharoen were the genre's first big stars, incorporating influences from Latin America, Asia and, especially, American film soundtracks and country music.

outgoing.name: Nationalism
